_comment: v10.1 training drills. A feeder on the far side plays one ball at a time; the drill ends after `balls`. Feed targets are relative to the player's half: dx from the centre line as the player sees it (negative = player's left), depth from the net. Points: quality (perfect/good/fair/bad) if the return lands in, plus bonuses.

rearHead.intro_zh: 球都喂到你的左后场（反手头顶区）。高而慢的球用马来步转身发力；平而快的球来不及转身，用中国跳截击。
rearHead.intro_en: Every feed goes to your rear backhand (round-the-head) corner. High, slow ones: Malaysian step and hit on the forehand. Flat, fast ones: no time to turn, China-jump.

tips_zh.good: 步法选得对：时间够就转身，时间紧就跳。
tips_zh.malayFast: 快球来不及转身：这类球用中国跳。
tips_zh.chinaSlow: 慢球可以从容转身发力，马来步更稳、更省腿。
tips_zh.none: 头顶区不处理步法就只能反手回，质量会掉。

tips_en.good: Right choices: turn when there is time, jump when there isn't.
tips_en.malayFast: No time to turn on the fast ones: China-jump those.
tips_en.chinaSlow: The slow ones give you time to turn: the Malaysian step is steadier and easier on the legs.
tips_en.none: Without footwork the round-the-head ball becomes a backhand and drops a grade.

defense.intro_zh: 对面连续杀球，轮流杀你的左边、右边和身体。挡网前（下滑）或挑后场（上滑）都可以，先求回到界内。
defense.intro_en: Smash after smash, to your left, right and body. Block short (swipe down) or lift deep (swipe up): first get it back in.

tips_zh.good: 防守稳：拍面提前准备好，借力挡回去。
tips_zh.early: 接杀偏早：球速再快，也要等它到身前再出手。
tips_zh.late: 接杀偏晚：重心放低、拍子提前举在身前。
tips_zh.out: 挡回去先求界内，不用打得太远。

tips_en.good: Solid defence: racket ready early, use the pace.
tips_en.early: Too early: however fast the smash, let it come to you.
tips_en.late: Too late: get low and have the racket up in front.
tips_en.out: Just get it back in; no need to hit it far.
